paragraphs: .Project Overview The Smart Home Alarm Controller is a hardware security system designed to monitor multiple sensor zones, process keypad PIN authentication, manage alarm conditions, and provide software access through an AHB interface. This project focuses on functional verification of the Smart Home Alarm Controller using SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology (UVM). The verification environment generates stimulus, observes DUT responses, checks expected behavior, and identifies functional bugs.
The verification environment contains the following components:
The verification environment is intended to identify functional issues such as:
features: Verify sensor detection and alarm activation.
Verify keypad PIN authentication, invalid attempts, lockout, and recovery.
Verify AHB register read and write operations.
Verify alarm priority and status reporting.
Identify design bugs through directed verification scenarios.
